name: Hajin
description: The new full-size battle royale map, shaped by the Modern Warfare 4 campaign along the Korean border. It doubles as the DMZ map. Drop spots include 14th Political Prison, Chang-San Air Base, Deadtown and Imjin Farmland.

name: Zodiac
description: A new Resurgence map built by Beenox with a moving train you can use for rotations. Early hot spots include Admin, Solar, Dispatch and Depot.

name: Avalon
description: A Blackout-inspired battle royale map that arrived in 2026. Look for the Golf Club, Trinity Stadium, Coastal Security and the Firing Range.

name: Haven’s Hollow
description: Still in the active rotation from late 2025.

name: Verdansk
description: The original Warzone map, back in rotation since April 2025.

name: Rebirth Island
description: The fast-paced Resurgence favorite, active again since April 2024.
